import requests

def check_ensembl_lengths():
    for sym in ["DNA2", "FBXW8"]:
        url = f"https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/{sym}?expand=1"
        r = requests.get(url, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}).json()
        gene_len = r["end"] - r["start"] + 1
        canonical_tr = [t for t in r.get("Transcript", []) if t.get("is_canonical") == 1]
        tr = canonical_tr[0] if canonical_tr else r.get("Transcript", [])[0]

        print(f"{sym}: gene length = {gene_len}, canonical transcript = {tr.get('id')}, length = {tr_len}")
        if "Translation" in tr:
            print(f"  translation length: {tr['Translation']['length']}")
